Message from the Dean

Where innovation meets impact

Dr. Turki N. BaroudDean, KFUPM Business School

At KFUPM Business School, we are reimagining business education for a new era defined by innovation, technology, and purpose.

As Saudi Arabia advances toward Vision 2030, KBS is shaping leaders who can bridge business and technology, turning ideas into real-world impact. Our programs empower students to think strategically, act entrepreneurially, and lead responsibly in a fast-changing global economy.

We believe that true business leadership today requires fluency in data, technology, and systems thinking, coupled with a deep sense of purpose and responsibility toward society.

Our faculty combine world-class scholarship with industry engagement, ensuring that every course, project, and partnership connects classroom learning with real business challenges. Through our global collaborations and deep ties to industry, we are building a learning ecosystem that equips graduates not just to adapt to change but to lead it. KBS will continue to evolve, expanding interdisciplinary programs, advancing impactful research, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset among students and executives alike.

Department Chairman

Dr. Mohammad Rabah Alshayeb

Chairman, Department of Information Systems & Operations Management

KFUPM Business School

BS Operations and Supply Chain

Driving performance through analytics-driven supply chain and operations

Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain05
Overview

Program Overview

  • Prepares students to improve organizational efficiency and supply chain performance through operations management, supply chain strategy, data analytics, forecasting, optimization, and digital technologies
  • Equips graduates to analyze and improve operational processes, manage sourcing, production, inventory, and logistics, and support data-driven planning and decision-making
  • Emphasizes analytics, AI-enabled forecasting, enterprise systems, resilience, and trade-off decisions across cost, service, speed, and risk
  • Prepares graduates for rising demand in operational excellence, supply chain resilience, digital planning, sourcing, and logistics roles
Disciplines and competencies covered
Supply chain
Operations
Quant/analytics/ computing
Global business
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain06
BS Operations and Supply Chain

Keeping the world moving

  • Leverages analytics, optimization, and digital technologies to drive operational excellence and supply chain performance in dynamic global markets
  • Combines supply chain strategy, forecasting, optimization, operations management, and digital technologies to enhance end-to-end operations
  • Structured as a progression from operational foundations to advanced supply chain analytics, optimization, and performance improvement
Career pathways
Supply chain transformationIntegrated business planningNetwork analyticsStrategic sourcingOperations excellenceDigital supply chainRisk & sustainability
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain07
BS Operations and Supply Chain

Career Prospects

01Supply Chain Transformation Manager

Leads multi-year initiatives to redesign the operating model and deliver measurable improvements in cost, service, and resilience

02Integrated Business Planning (IBP) / S&OP Manager

Owns cross-functional planning across demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial alignment

03Supply Chain Network Analytics Lead

Designs and optimizes supply networks for growth, localization, and mega-project scale-up

04Strategic Sourcing & Category Manager

Develops category strategies and supplier segmentation, and embeds analytics into sourcing decisions

05Operations Excellence Consultant

Leads continuous improvement across production, warehousing, and service operations

06Digital Supply Chain Leader

Builds sense-and-respond operations with integrated data, dashboards, and control-tower capabilities

07Supply Chain Risk & Sustainability Manager

Strengthens continuity and resilience and advances sustainability across end-to-end operations

Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain08
BS Operations and Supply Chain · Practical training

Summer Training & Internship

Every student gains real workplace experience before graduating. The degree plan comes in two tracks, so you choose how you get it: a summer training placement or a full-semester internship.

Track 1
Summer Training
OSC 399
1credit hour
128CR degree plan
When
The summer after the junior year
Track 2
Internship
OSC 398
6credit hours
127CR degree plan
When
A full semester: senior year, semester 1
Prerequisites
At least 85 credit hours and ENGL 214
Where it fits in the four years
SummerYear 1Year 2Year 3SummerYear 4
InternshipYear 1Year 2Year 3Y4 S1Y4 S2
Students apply operations, analytics and supply chain skills to real business problems in a professional setting. Both tracks also include the two-semester Senior Project (OSC 411 & 412) in the senior year.

  • Project management

  • Layout
  • MRP/ERP

  • Make-buy

AI for Forecasting and Operations Planning

OSC 310
Pre-requisiteOSC 210Topics13
  • Practical insights and methodologies on AI for Forecasting planning in operations & supply chain
  • Demand variability and uncertainty in planning
  • Forecasting accuracy
  • Forecast bias and error diagnosis
  • Time-series forecasting with statistical methods
  • AI & machine learning for forecasting
  • Explainable forecasting AI models
  • Capacity planning under constraints
  • Production, inventory, and materials planning logic
  • AI-based forecasting for uncertain demand
  • Capacity and resource planning under constraints
  • Sales and operations planning (S&OP)
  • Integrated AI-based planning

BS Operations and Supply Chain new course descriptions
NewCore

Intelligent Enterprise Systems

OSC 320
Pre-requisiteBAI 220 and OSC 210Topics10
  • Role of enterprise systems in operational coordination
  • ERP concepts and core transactional processes
  • Master data and operational data management
  • Performance monitoring using dashboards and KPIs
  • Execution visibility and exception management
  • Analytics embedded in enterprise systems
  • Data-driven decision workflows
  • Cross-organizational information integration
  • Governance, controls, and system accountability
  • Managing change and system adoption

BS Operations and Supply Chain new course descriptions
NewCore

Sourcing and Procurement

OSC 331
Pre-requisiteOSC 210Topics11
  • The strategic role of procurement within organizations and supply chains
  • Sourcing strategy
  • Supplier selection
  • Contract management
  • Performance evaluation
  • Procurement governance
  • Supplier relationships
  • Negotiation
  • Category management
  • Spreadsheet-based cost modeling and decision analysis
  • Experiential components such as negotiation exercises and simulation are also incorporated
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain17
BS Operations and Supply Chain new course descriptions
NewCore

Decision and Risk Analytics

OSC 340
Pre-requisiteOSC 210Topics4
  • Introduction to decision analysis and prescriptive analytics for supply chain and operations decisions
  • Decision challenges, foundations of decision analysis, decision quality and process design, decision framing using influence diagrams, stakeholder objectives and value measures, and alternative development
  • Deterministic modeling using spreadsheet tools, including net present value, scenario, and sensitivity analysis
  • Probability foundations, uncertainty quantification, Monte Carlo simulation, decision trees, risk attitude, value of information, constrained optimization, portfolio resource allocation, and communication and implementation of analytical decisions
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain18
BS Operations and Supply Chain new course descriptions
NewCore

Analytics for Performance Excellence

OSC 410
Pre-requisiteOSC 310Topics10
  • Performance excellence in operations and supply chains
  • Performance measurement systems and KPIs
  • Process variation and performance risk
  • Root-cause analysis and diagnostic analytics
  • Predictive analytics for performance improvement
  • Prescriptive analytics for improvement prioritization
  • Lean principles supported by data
  • Six Sigma concepts and DMAIC framework
  • Statistical process control fundamentals
  • Benchmarking and continuous improvement programs
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain19
BS Operations and Supply Chain new course descriptions
NewCore

Sustainable Operations

OSC 450
Pre-requisiteOSC 340Topics4
  • Introduction to sustainability principles into operations and supply chain management
  • Sustainability frameworks, operations strategy, sustainability performance measurement, carbon accounting and emissions analysis, sustainable process design, and life cycle assessment
  • Circular economy systems, sustainable supply chain, inventory and transportation decisions, quality improvement methodologies, digital transformation, and project management for sustainability
  • Emphasis on carbon footprint evaluation, analytical tools and managerial decision-making
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain20

Core

Human Factors Engineering

ISE 443
Pre-requisiteSTAT 214Topics7
  • Study of human response into man-machine systems
  • Study of visual displays as a medium of input
  • Auditory and tactual displays
  • Human control of systems
  • Control tools and related devices
  • Applied anthropometry and workplace design

Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain23
BS Operations and Supply Chain new course descriptions
Core

Supply Chain Systems Modeling

ISE 470
Pre-requisiteISE 402Topics4
  • This course adopts a modeling approach to supply chains that is designed to study trade-offs between system costs and customer service
  • Supply chain design, multi-location inventory-distribution models, bullwhip effect, delayed differentiation, and e-commerce and supply chain
  • The key insights provided by such system-wide models will be illustrated through the use of software packages, real cases discussion and presentations and term projects
  • In addition, the course will highlight the role of information technology in supporting supply chain operations
Source: KBSBS Operations & Supply Chain24
